payout_quote: You must open a new U.S. Bank Smartly Checking account either online through the promotional offer web page, in a branch, or over the phone from September 10, 2026, through and including November 10, 2026. The account must be funded with at least $25 within 60 days of account opening... Additionally, you must enroll in the U.S. Bank Mobile App or online banking within 90 days of opening your account. You must also complete two or more direct deposits within 90 days of opening your account that total: $2,000 to $4,999.99 to earn the $250 bonus, $5,000 to $7,999.99 to earn the $350 bonus, or $8,000 or more to earn the $450 bonus. A direct deposit is an electronic deposit of your paycheck made through the Automated Clearing House (ACH) network or an electronic deposit of your government benefits... Other electronic deposits or person-to-person payments are not considered a direct deposit. Your checking bonus will be credited to your new checking account within 30 days following the completion of all the offer requirements. (Official U.S. Bank offer disclosures, crawled 2026-09-23)
timing: Bonus credited within 30 days after all requirements are completed
eligibility: New U.S. Bank consumer checking customers (no existing account, none in last 12 months, no U.S. Bank checking bonus in past 12 months); open 9/10/26 - 11/10/26
steps: Open a new U.S. Bank Smartly Checking account through the promotional offer page (or in branch/phone with banker activation) by November 10, 2026
Fund with at least $25 within 60 days
Enroll in the U.S. Bank mobile app or online banking within 90 days
Complete 2+ direct deposits within 90 days totaling $2,000+ ($250), $5,000+ ($350), or $8,000+ ($450)
Bonus credits within 30 days of completing everything
catches: Requires TWO or more direct deposits (not one lump sum) totaling the tier threshold
Direct deposit = paycheck/government ACH only - Venmo, Zelle, Cash App, and bank transfers do NOT count
Must open through the promotional page or have a banker activate it - a regular application may not attach the offer
New customers only: no U.S. Bank checking in the last 12 months
biggest_catch: You need at least two separate direct deposits totaling $2,000+ within 90 days - and they must be real payroll/government ACH deposits, not transfers from your other accounts.
